desc: Prepare the CHEAPEST networking path, so the machine is not waiting on PCIe. MEASURED: the full kernel already has CONFIG_BRCMFMAC=y and CONFIG_CFG80211=y, so WiFi needs no kernel work — it is gated entirely on PCIe op-115 (tickets 068/124) plus firmware. But USB networking is NOT enabled at all: CONFIG_USB_NET_DRIVERS, CONFIG_USB_USBNET and CONFIG_USB_RTL8152 are all absent. A USB ethernet dongle would give the machine an IP address as soon as the USB host link works (096/097/132), well before PCIe is understood. TASK: enable USB_NET_DRIVERS, USB_USBNET plus the common dongle drivers (RTL8152/8153, ASIX AX88179, CDC_ETHER, CDC_NCM), and add a minimal DHCP client and busybox networking to the image. Cheap, offline, and it converts the USB milestone directly into networking.
author: claude
